name: phonon-webgpu
description: Phonon 31M text-to-speech on WebGPU, with the time of every word.

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2022 --outfile=dist/phonon.js && esbuild demo/demo.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2022 --outfile=docs/demo.js && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
